notes.title: Valentines Day Update - It's time to go to the Prom!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404122/93bb6276035cc75f212ad614c70e3ca7dc1fce21.jpg[/img]

It's finally time to go to Prom!
For this super special Valentine's day update you finally get to take your date to the prom, dance, and see who is crowned the school royalty!

Make sure that you start a new save for this update, It'll prevent crashes, and also there's plenty of new content throughout that  you might've missed!

notes.title: December Content Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404122/f2f73698a0138f6561e5cbb1b3dc540745a7bb21.jpg[/img]
The new Winning Love by Daylight Episode [1+2] December content release is now live!

Note: It's recommended to start a fresh save with each content update to prevent crashes (Often when things are added in the middle of the game, it will cause problems for existing saves)


Changelog:
-5 New achievements added
-A secret postgame unlockable added
-Several Easter Eggs added
-Lots of new content added (Now at 80,000 words!)
-Lots of content updated to play smoother, or have more new art
